mechanism.claim: Persistent cross-sectional leadership order across the first and second halves of a completed six-hour alt-perpetual block identifies durable relative price discovery. During elevated BTC variation, follow the common second-half alt and BTC direction when that leadership-order persistence first enters its strict-prior tail.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of median second-half alt return and BTC second-half return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCARP compares the exact cross-alt ranks of six first-half returns with their ranks in the second half. Prior cross-alt work used breadth, residuals, or leadership, and prior BTC temporal-rank work ranked one asset's price levels against minute order; none is this fixed two-half cross-sectional leadership-order persistence geometry.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC completed six-hour variation strict-prior rank >=0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: hourly false-to-true onsets of exact six-alt two-half rank persistence are absent from known Gross9 primitives

features.aligned_window: 360 exact aligned unique bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-6h,D) per symbol
features.source_valid: finite positive coherent OHLC for every symbol and timestamp; exactly 360 rows per symbol with no duplicate, missing, nearest-time join, or imputation
features.alt_first_half_return: for each alt, natural log(last close/first open) over the first 180 aligned minutes [D-6h,D-3h)
features.alt_second_half_return: for each alt, natural log(last close/first open) over the last 180 aligned minutes [D-3h,D)
features.strict_cross_section: all six first-half returns and all six second-half returns are finite and strictly distinct within their half; ties invalidate the decision and receive no tie handling
features.rank_persistence: Spearman rank correlation across the six alts between first-half and second-half returns: assign unique ascending ranks R1_j and R2_j in {1,...,6}, then rho = 1 - 6*sum_j((R1_j-R2_j)^2)/(6*(6^2-1)); rho must be finite
features.rank_persistence_rank: strict-prior midrank of rho over at most 2,160 valid hourly decisions, minimum 1,440, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.btc_variation: sum of 360 squared natural-log BTC close/open returns over [D-6h,D)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2,160 valid hourly decisions, minimum 1,440, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.direction_inputs: median of the six second-half alt returns and BTC natural log(last close/first open) over the same last 180 minutes
features.direction_confirmation: the median second-half alt return is strictly nonzero and the BTC second-half return shares its sign
features.eligible_state: rank-persistence, BTC-variation, and direction-confirmation gates pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid hour ineligible; a missing or source-invalid previous hour cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all seven completed six-hour paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal-time entry
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

definitions.second_half_rank_reversal: replace the primary strict-prior rank-persistence gate with current Spearman rho<=-0.80 while retaining the same strict cross-section and direction rule
definitions.one_hour_stale_features: use the complete feature geometry from D-1h on the unchanged clock
definitions.direction_flip: negate the candidate side on the unchanged event set and clock
definitions.forced_long: force long on the unchanged event set and clock

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, window, half, formula, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or gate repair
